# Block `table`

**Use:** Comparisons and structured facts: rows of items, columns of properties.

**Avoid:** A single column of items — use list.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "table",
  "headers": [
    "Structure",
    "Lookup",
    "Range scan"
  ],
  "rows": [
    [
      "Hash index",
      "O(1)",
      "No"
    ],
    [
      "B+ tree",
      "O(log n)",
      "Yes"
    ]
  ],
  "caption": "Index structures compared.",
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"table"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `headers` | array of string | yes |
| `rows` | array of array of string | yes |
| `caption` | string | no |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
